covenant.quote:
5.9 Leverage Ratio.
On a consolidated basis, maintain a Leverage Ratio as of each Measurement Date of not more than the applicable ratio set forth below for the

4.50 to 1.00

evidence.quote:
"Leverage Ratio"
means, as of any date of determination, with respect to Hyatt and its Subsidiaries on a consolidated basis, the ratio of (a) Consolidated Adjusted Funded Debt as of the last day of the twelve month period ending on the last day of the fiscal
quarter most recently ended on or prior to such date to (b) Consolidated EBITDA for the twelve month period ending on the last day of such fiscal quarter.

evidence.quote:
"Consolidated Adjusted Funded Debt" means, as of any date of determination,
without duplication, (a) the aggregate principal amount of all Funded Debt of Hyatt and its Subsidiaries on a consolidated basis minus (b) the lesser of (i) $300,000,000 and (ii) the aggregate outstanding principal amount of
all Guaranty Obligations

evidence.quote:
minus (b) the lesser of (i) $300,000,000 and (ii) the aggregate outstanding principal amount of
all Guaranty Obligations of Hyatt or any of its Subsidiaries of Funded Debt of all other Persons

amendments_considered.what_changed: Separate delayed-draw term loan Credit Agreement dated April 11, 2025 (not an amendment of the revolver); not labeled here.

draft_notes: No amendments to the May 18, 2022 Credit Agreement were found in EDGAR full-text search (8-K/10-Q/10-K); it was replaced by the October 30, 2025 Credit Agreement.
Leverage Ratio uses Consolidated EBITDA annualized for the June 30, 2022 (x2) and September 30, 2022 (x4/3) Measurement Dates; test_period labeled ttm.
Qualified Acquisition step-up to 5.50x (from and after June 30, 2023, up to four Measurement Dates) excluded from schedule per README rule 3.

Consolidated Adjusted Funded Debt deductions (b) and (c) are each capped at $300,000,000; modeled as separate 'cap' terms. Deduction (d) is the lesser of excess cash over $100,000,000 and Funded Debt maturing within 12 months, not representable in the cap schema.
Funded Debt children are paraphrased short labels for clauses (a)-(j); verify wording preference.
effective_to convention: last test date the level applies to.
